statement_summary: Maintain a documented security program
Owner designated security lead for panel and business systems
Annual risk assessment covering the 300i-2(a)(1)(A) elements
Risk decision rules; disinfection risks never accepted at High
Annual evaluation with an outside reviewer every second year
Annual policy review
Sanctions for any future workforce
Contractor sanctions; loss of remote access after an unapproved connection
Portal is the only allowed remote path
Integrator account disabled except approved, logged sessions
New program copy and settings check after every panel change
Security terms in agreements with anyone who can reach the panel
Vendor list and annual portal SOC 2 review
One account per person; no shared credentials
App-based MFA on portal, billing, and email
Unique passphrases; change defaults; no saved portal password
Quarterly account review
Standard daily laptop account
Sealed emergency access envelope
Monthly portal sign-in and setpoint review
Three-level classification
Full-disk encryption on every device
Two owner-held copies of the PLC program and HMI project
Compliance record retention periods; spreadsheet in the file account
Shredding; device wipe or certified destruction with a record
Delete exports; monthly printed contact list in the binder
Official software sources; updates and antivirus on
Quarterly firmware and advisory check; component inventory
Router outbound only; remote administration off
AI tools only after P10 assessment; notices from agency templates
Annual training; relief operator briefing
Incident runbook with printed contacts
Same-day incident log with discovery time
Treat the water first: hand feed and 4-hour grab samples
Primacy agency consultation and notice deadlines
No ransom without legal advice and an OFAC check
Annual walkthrough with the relief operator; lessons learned
Manual-operation sheet in the well house
Relief agreement covers emergencies; annual hand-operation drill
Written PLC restore steps
